2609.24433.title: FoldQuantVLA: Native Low-Bit Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models via Consistent Folding
2609.24433.paper_summary: Low-bit vision-language-action inference must reduce observation-to-action latency while preserving robot behavior. We present FoldQuantVLA, a post-training quantization framework that carries a consistent activation representation through calibration, weight rounding, and native integer execution. It combines channel scaling and block Hadamard transforms with dynamic per-token quantization, without policy retraining. Custom TensorRT plugins execute projections in both the language backbone and iterative action expert with four-bit weights and activations (W4A4) on Ada GPUs and Jetson AGX Orin. Evaluation spans LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and two robot platforms. Across three GR00T checkpoints and $π_{0.5}$, W4A4 achieves $1.20$ to $1.33\times$ speedups over floating-point TensorRT on Orin and $1.25$ to $1.52\times$ on desktop. Retaining language attention-output and feed-forward down projections at eight bits (W8A8) improves held-out action fidelity on all four checkpoints. Across four real-robot tasks, this configuration raises observed GR00T N1.7 success from $80.0\%$ with uniform W4A4 to $92.5\%$ over 80 trials per configuration, with a measured additional Orin latency of 1 ms.
2609.24433.paper_summary_zh: 低位元視覺-語言-行動推斷必須在保持機器人行為的同時減少觀察到行動的延遲。我們提出了FoldQuantVLA，一個後訓練量化框架，通過校準、權重四捨五入和原生整數執行來保持一致的激活表示。它結合了通道縮放和區塊哈達瑪變換，並使用動態每標記量化，而無需重新訓練策略。自定義TensorRT插件在語言骨幹和迭代行動專家中執行四位權重和激活（W4A4）的投影，適用於Ada GPU和Jetson AGX Orin。評估範圍涵蓋LIBERO、SimplerEnv和兩個機器人平台。在三個GR00T檢查點和$π_{0.5}$中，W4A4在Orin上實現了$1.20$到$1.33\times$的速度提升，而在桌面上則為$1.25$到$1.52\times$。在所有四個檢查點中，保留語言注意輸出和前饋下投影於八位（W8A8）改善了保留行動的保真度。在四個真實機器人任務中，這一配置使觀察到的GR00T N1.7成功率從使用均勻W4A4的$80.0\%$提高到每個配置80次試驗中的$92.5\%$，並測得額外的Orin延遲為1毫秒。
